summary: Passbolt is an open-source, collaborative password manager designed to help teams securely store and share sensitive credentials. It provides a central platform for managing access permissions across organisations, using an AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: Teams looking for a self-hosted credential management system that supports collaborative access control and open-source auditing.
watchOut: Self-hosting a team password manager introduces a single point of failure and a high-value target, requiring careful backup strategies and security hardening.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves setting up a containerised stack using Docker or Kubernetes, which will usually require a persistent volume for data and a separate database instance.
